case_name: Chander Prakash v. State of Rajasthan

pages.text:
IN THE SUPREME COURT OF INDIA
CRIMINAL APPELLATE JURISDICTION
Chander Prakash ... Appellant
versus
State of Rajasthan ... Respondent
Coram: P.S. Kailasam, O. Chinnappa Reddy, JJ.
Judgment Dated: 18 April 1980

CHINNAPPA REDDY, J.:
1. The appellant, who was employed as a store-keeper and billing clerk in a government agricultural cooperative store, was convicted under Section 381 IPC for theft of fertilizer bags and cash belonging to his employer.

2. Ingredients of Section 381 IPC: Section 381 IPC penalizes theft committed by a clerk or servant of property in the possession of his master or employer. It carries enhanced punishment up to seven years imprisonment because of the fiduciary relationship and trust reposed in employees.

3. Decision: The evidence established that the appellant was in service as a clerk and dishonestly removed goods from the warehouse out of his employer's custody. The conviction under Section 381 IPC is well-founded.
